claims.statement: The curated knowledge trees are decisions/, troubleshooting/, plus the root pages overview.md and maintenance-format.md; pages under them are authored directly by the distilling agent or maintainer in OKF format and their entry identity is the filename stem unique within its tree.

The AKSK curation contract lives between <!-- AKSK:WIKI-CONTRACT:BEGIN --> and <!-- AKSK:WIKI-CONTRACT:END --> markers inside openwiki/INSTRUCTIONS.md; OpenWiki-owned content outside those markers takes precedence and hand-editing between them is prohibited.

attach_wiki_contract.mjs appends the templated curation section to an existing openwiki/INSTRUCTIONS.md, never creates the file, preserves all OpenWiki-owned content, and fails fast with exit 2 and the verbatim prerequisite `openwiki --init` when the file is missing with no writes.

The attachment is idempotent and self-updating: re-running when the marked section already matches the template is a no-op (reports already up to date), and when the template changed only the content between AKSK:WIKI-CONTRACT markers is refreshed in place.

Preserve-and-link semantics require that when openwiki --update would regenerate a page under a curated tree, the AKSK-authored page is kept and generated material links to it instead of replacing it, and all aksk_* frontmatter extension fields survive update round-trips.

Descriptive lessons distilled from session bundles bypass the openwiki --update CLI; distillation authors pages directly and refreshes indexes deterministically via sync_wiki_indexes.mjs, while openwiki --update remains only the scheduled reconciliation path.

Curated pages extend OKF base frontmatter (type, title, description, tags, timestamp) with aksk_status required on decisions/ pages (values accepted, superseded, provisional), optional aksk_superseded_by successor slug, and optional aksk_depends_on list of qualified references decisions/<slug> or troubleshooting/<slug> where slug equals the target filename stem.

Distillation routes by kind per distill-routing: descriptive lessons (facts, rationale, decisions, troubleshooting) become OKF pages under openwiki/{decisions,troubleshooting}/ or topical openwiki/ pages, while prescriptive lessons (agent behavior rules and multi-step procedures) stay in .agents/AGENTS.md or .agents/playbooks/; a SHALL requirement already codified in openspec/specs/ must not be duplicated as a wiki page.

Distillation fails closed before writing any wiki output if the openwiki/openspec peer binaries are not on PATH or if openwiki/INSTRUCTIONS.md lacks the AKSK:WIKI-CONTRACT markers (including the default stub case); on peer-tool absence it prints one error per missing tool plus the exact install commands and exits 2 without writes.

check_peer_tools.mjs verifies peer binaries by PATH resolution only, never attempts installation; it exports INSTALL_COMMANDS (openspec -> npm i -g @fission-ai/openspec@latest, openwiki -> npm i -g openwiki@latest), onPath, missing, and requireBinaries, rejects unknown tool names with exit 2, and prints remediation on failure.

sync_wiki_indexes.mjs refreshes all directory indexes deterministically without invoking openwiki --update by locating the global package via npm root -g, dynamically importing agent/docs-only-backend.js and okf/index-sync.js, constructing OpenWikiLocalShellBackend with docsOnly true and virtualMode true, and calling synchronizeWikiIndexes; it exits 2 if openwiki is uninitialized or the package is missing.

Runtime validation after authoring uses openwiki/dist/okf/frontmatter.js validateOkfFrontmatter and authoring guidance from openwiki/dist/agent/prompt.js createSystemPrompt(init|update), fixing all reported issues before continuing; filename-stem uniqueness and frontmatter conformance are also verified by docs-lint.

The Documentation budget inside the AKSK:WIKI-CONTRACT block constrains OpenWiki to an agent navigation aid: Keep repository map, architecture/flows, conventions/extension points, invariants, and links to specs; Do not generate spec restatements, per-file summaries, API references, release notes, generated/vendor docs, or paraphrase-only pages; update a page only on boundary/flow/convention/invariant changes and link to openspec/specs/<capability>/spec.md for feature behavior.

The repo-root .openwikiignore uses anchored /example/ plus .agents/sessions/ with !.agents/sessions/README.md exception, commented dependency/build/cache, generated/vendor, and secrets categories, never excludes openspec/specs/** or openspec/changes/archive/**, and is merge-not-clobber (missing creates, no markers appends, markers refresh only).

The wiki-contract attachment is available at both .agents/skills/aksk-init/scripts/attach_wiki_contract.mjs and .agents/skills/aksk-bootstrap/scripts/attach_wiki_contract.mjs with the same marker-driven append/refresh behavior; either path attaches or refreshes the AKSK:WIKI-CONTRACT block.
